name: minitude
description: Minitude: answer rare, shrink far. A pixel-art trivia game.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @minitude/server" "npm run dev -w @minitude/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @minitude/core && npm run build -w @minitude/web && npm run build -w @minitude/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @minitude/core && npm run test -w @minitude/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @minitude/core && npm run typecheck -w @minitude/web && npm run typecheck -w @minitude/server
